from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# Focus on the frame footer/index and keep a valid-looking header start.
for i in range(len(b)-512, len(b)-8):
    if i >= 0:
        b[i] = (b[i] ^ 0x3C) & 0xFF
# Also corrupt the chunk flags in the first chunk to try to hit lazychunk construction
for i in range(32, 40):
    if i < len(b):
        b[i] = 0xFF
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b)
print('written', len(b))
